caption: The drawing features a single metal spur depicted against a plain, light beige background. The spur is primarily dark brown, possibly made of iron or steel, and features a high degree of detail, showing metallic texture and patina. One end of the spur is composed of a curved metal band with squared, pierced ends designed to attach to a boot. The other end transitions into a large, circular, rotating rowel with many long, evenly spaced pointed spikes radiating outward. The neck of the spur, connecting the rowel to the curved band, is reinforced with what appear to be wrapped metal bands or decorative elements, colored in a bronze or gold-tone, providing contrast with the darker body of the object. The drawing is centered, and no additional objects or embellishments are present on the blank background.
title: Spur
